honing_confound: Esoteric skill damage at 1-orb scales with Specialization; cycling frequency scales with Swiftness. Tier standing reflects T4 rapid-Esoteric uptime value.

delivery.evidence: Striker (male martial artist counterpart to Wardancer) uses fast kick combos and chi chi punches. Esoteric Flurry emphasizes frequent Esoteric skill use at 1 orb — skills: Lightning Tiger Strike, Moon Flash Kick, Tiger Emerges, Sweeping Kick (Esoteric type). Fast sequential delivery.

footprint.evidence: Esoteric skills at 1-orb create smaller AoE than Wardancer's ESE (which waits for 4 orbs). Rapid smaller impacts rather than single large burst.

geo_text: Esoteric Flurry Striker uses Esoteric skills frequently at 1-orb cost for rapid sequential damage. Orbs regenerate between Esoteric uses, enabling fast cycling. High attack speed + rapid skill sequencing creates a 'constant momentum' feel. All melee range.

control.evidence: Some Striker skills apply knockback. Tiger-themed aesthetic suggests powerful strikes but no CC identity.

defense.evidence: Striker has excellent mobility (fast kicks, dashes). Defense through movement.

economy.resource_verbatim: Esoteric Meter (4 orbs maximum) — Esoteric Flurry: use at 1 orb frequently
economy.builder_source: Normal skills generate Esoteric orbs. Esoteric Flurry identity: Esoteric skills can be used at 1 orb (vs 4-orb requirement in other contexts). Orbs regenerate rapidly.
economy.plain_text: RAPID ORB CYCLING: Esoteric Flurry enables Esoteric skills to be used at 1-orb cost. Instead of saving for 4-orb maximum burst (like Deathblow), Esoteric skills fire rapidly and frequently at 1-orb. The result: Esoteric skills become sustained rapid-fire abilities rather than occasional burst cooldowns. Trade: lower peak damage per skill vs much higher frequency.

element.evidence: Striker skills use lightning chi aesthetics. Physical/Magic damage per specific skill.

movement.evidence: Very high mobility — Striker is one of the fastest ground-movement MA classes. Several skills are dashes or movement attacks.

attr.evidence: Pure melee martial artist. Point-blank engagement.

range.evidence: All melee. Some kick extensions reach slightly further.

tempo.evidence: Esoteric Flurry is sustained: rapid 1-orb Esoteric skill cycling creates constant output. No burst window — Esoteric skills fire as fast as orbs can be regenerated.

amp.value: Esoteric skills usable at 1 orb; rapid cycling provides sustained amplification vs 4-orb burst cadence
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Esoteric Flurry identity specifically enables 1-orb Esoteric skill use.

commitment.evidence: 1-orb Esoteric skills are faster casts than 4-orb heavy strikes. Rapid delivery.

mechanics_notes: 1) Esoteric Flurry vs Deathblow is the Striker version of the 'fast sustained vs slow burst' split seen in Wardancer (FI vs ESE), Sorceress (Reflux vs Igniter), and Scrapper (Taijutsu vs Shock Training). This recurring binary is the most common identity fork design in LA. 2) Striker is Wardancer's male counterpart — same archetype, same orb system, similar skills. The key difference in LA design: Striker's Esoteric skills are slightly different in geometry (Wardancer's Esoteric = large wide AoE chi bursts; Striker's Esoteric = more directional chi-wave attacks). 3) Rapid Esoteric cycling creates a 'flash of kicks' playstyle — very satisfying to play, very high APM ceiling. The temporal feel is constant motion rather than build-release.
stabilization_patch: Esoteric Flurry gained significant favor 2023-2024 as players found the rapid-cycle feel more practical than Deathblow's timing demands.
tier_standing_current: A-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Swiftness + Specialization combination; rapid cycling advantage scales with attack speed from Swiftness investment.

honing_confound: Deathblow's 3-orb Esoteric skill burst is the most gear-sensitive identity in the Striker archetype — maximum single-hit damage scales exponentially with Specialization at T4 ceiling. Tier standing reflects the burst ceiling at maximum honing.

delivery.evidence: Deathblow emphasizes 3-orb Esoteric skills for single massive damage outputs. Primary Esoteric skills at 3 orbs: Tiger Emerges, Sky Shattering Blow, Esoteric Reaction — these are heavy single-strike or small-radius impact Esoteric skills.

footprint.evidence: Deathblow's 3-orb Esoteric skills hit in focused small-radius bursts — heavy but concentrated rather than wide AoE.

geo_text: Deathblow Striker saves orbs for maximum 3-orb Esoteric skill bursts. Generate 3 orbs via Normal skills → unleash 3-orb Esoteric skill for devastating output. Then rebuild. The identity rhythm is most similar to a classic 'charge and release' burst pattern.

economy.resource_verbatim: Esoteric Meter (3 orbs required for Deathblow Esoteric skills) — Deathblow: requires 3 orbs for max output
economy.builder_source: Normal skills generate orbs. Deathblow identity: Esoteric skills require 3 orbs and deal maximum damage at 3-orb cost.
economy.plain_text: 3-ORB GATE: Deathblow Esoteric skills require 3 orbs (vs Esoteric Flurry's 1-orb rapid fire). Generate 3 orbs via Normal skill rotation → unleash 3-orb Esoteric skill for massive single-hit damage → rebuild. The economy is 'save, then spend everything at once.' Patience identity.

tempo.evidence: Deathblow is the burst identity: wait for 3 orbs → fire Esoteric skill for maximum damage → rebuild. Classic build-release.

amp.value: 3-orb Esoteric skills deal significantly more damage than 1-orb (Deathblow identity amplifies 3-orb burst output substantially)
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Specific multipliers not confirmed from live sources.

commitment.evidence: 3-orb Esoteric skills have heavy charge animations — the 'deathblow' delivery requires a wind-up commit.

mechanics_notes: 1) Deathblow is the 'patience and one big hit' Striker identity — the player resists using Esoteric skills early (at 1-2 orbs) in favor of maximum damage at 3. This patience discipline is the skill expression. 2) Same structural position as Arcanist Empress's Grace (wait for max stacks before detonating) but in orb form. 3) Deathblow was historically the preferred Striker identity at higher honing tiers where the 3-orb burst damage ceiling is disproportionately high. At lower honing, Esoteric Flurry's frequency was better. This creates a genuine 'gear threshold' effect where one identity is preferred at low-gear and another at high-gear. HONING-CONFOUND in action.
